name: signum-decoder

scripts.frontend:data: npm run glossary:data && npm run build --silent && node dist/src/cli/frontend-data.js
scripts.frontend:dev: npm run frontend:data && npm run --workspace frontend dev
scripts.frontend:build: npm run frontend:data && npm run --workspace frontend build
scripts.frontend:check: npm run frontend:data && npm run --workspace frontend check
scripts.frontend:preview: npm run frontend:data && npm run --workspace frontend preview
scripts.format: prettier --write "src/**/*.ts" "tests/**/*.ts" "frontend/src/**/*.{ts,svelte}" package.json frontend/package.json tsconfig.json frontend/tsconfig.json eslint.config.js "scripts/*.mjs" ".github/**/*.{md,yml,yaml,json}" docs/AUTHORITY.md "cases/README.md" "docs/architecture/**/*.md" "docs/product/system/**/*.md" AGENTS.md ARCHITECTURE.md README.md CONTRIBUTING.md SECURITY.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check "src/**/*.ts" "tests/**/*.ts" "frontend/src/**/*.{ts,svelte}" package.json frontend/package.json tsconfig.json frontend/tsconfig.json eslint.config.js "scripts/*.mjs" ".github/**/*.{md,yml,yaml,json}" docs/AUTHORITY.md "cases/README.md" "docs/architecture/**/*.md" "docs/product/system/**/*.md" AGENTS.md ARCHITECTURE.md README.md CONTRIBUTING.md SECURITY.md

description: Decoding advertisements with a local vision model: observations, contestable interpretations, and controlled semiotic concepts, in the spirit of Judith Williamson.
